name: Meat-Cute
source:
Have you ever summoned a demon by accident?

One night, bored after a kill, a serial killer decides to try a demon summoning ritual her friend suggested; Thinking nothing of it, she tries it with the blood of her victim. The ritual works, and now there’s a cute yet naive demon in her living room.

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/meat-cute]itch.io[/url]]
